newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Uralmash sees July foreign listing.
newsitem.headline: Russia Uralmash sees July foreign listing.

text.p: Russian heavy machine maker Uralmash Industries will list its shares on a foreign stock exchange in July, preparatory to issuing a global depositary receipt, the company and its advisers said on Friday.
A separate listing on the Russian Trading System's RTS-2 had been agreed and shares could begin trading there in 1-3 weeks, they said.

"We are now preparing for the second stage -- issuing shares on the international market," said Dmitry Solomin, president of issue coordinator Neftyanoi Investitsionny Dom. "By our calculation, that will be the beginning of July this year."
Uralmash Industries will issue 4.5 million shares, or 26.87 percent of voting stock, that will be worth $40-$45 million, the company said in a statement.
It is negotiating a listing with a U.S. and two European exchanges and may make a decision in 2-3 weeks, Flemings, which is leading the issue with CentreInvest, said.
Yekaterinburg-based Uralmash (OAO Uralsky Zavod Tyazhelogo Mashinostroyeniya) makes drilling, mining and metallurgical equipment.

Solomin said an American Depositary Receipt (ADRs) programme to improve foreign share liquidity would begin immediately after the new issue by OAO Uralmash-Zavody (Uralmash Industries), a holding company for Uralmash and ZMSK heavy equipment makers.
Uralmash Industries has completed share consolidation with OAO Uralmash and OAO ZSMK, it said. Foreign shareholders have about 40 percent of stock in the new company.
Ernst and Young said it expected to present recalculated Uralmash results for 1995 and 1996 to international accounting standards by July 25.
